title: Test
description: Test as a design consideration that every design shall address (4.2). Generic framework content.
guidance: Answer each item for the review stage. A No needs an Action, a Risk or a justification approved by the Discipline Lead (4.5). Items are Draft starter content for review.

items.question: Are verification needs that require test identified?
Are test facilities and rigs needed identified?
Are test schedules aligned with the design programme?
Are test requirements and success criteria defined?
Are test articles and their configuration defined?
Are test procedures available or planned for every test-based verification?
Are test results recorded as Verifications with their effectivity and basis revisions?
Are installation and functional test requirements for the aircraft defined?

draft_note: Starter checklist items, Draft: to be reviewed with the framework owner before Framework v1.0 release.
